[P1] Require retirement evidence to cover previously observed activity

Comparing only start events accepts a stale retirement snapshot that omits later activity. For example, the original evidence can contain `late_activity` at 25000 while the snapshot retains matching starts but declares retirement at 21000. Both this comparison and `validate_retirement_evidence` accept that snapshot because the latter only checks its own observation window. Failed cases skip final validation of the original evidence, so the lease is released as quiescent and another exclusive case can start. Require retirement coverage and settlement times to cover the frozen observations, preserving previously observed activity and completion facts. Add a regression test using an older retirement snapshot.
